errors.evidence: The description lists the categories in one sentence and their corresponding percentages in the next sentence using the word “分别为” (respectively), which implies a one-to-one mapping. However, the order is incorrect, leading to wrong mappings. For example, it implies that '经济' (Economy) is 6% (it is actually 2%), '政治' (Politics) is 14% (it is 6%), and '文化' (Culture) is 2% (it is 14%).
